description: This file contains implementation of the CJ125 sensor logic, including heater control, initialization, mode setting, and communication with hardware registers. It defines the CJ125 class methods for sensor management in an engine control system.

classes.name: CJ125
classes.description: Class representing the CJ125 sensor, managing heater control, communication, and mode configuration.

methods.name: CJ125::CJ125
methods.description: Constructor initializing heater control and PID configuration.

methods.name: CJ125::SetHeater
methods.description: Sets the heater duty cycle with safety and voltage-based limitations.

methods.name: CJ125::SetIdleHeater
methods.description: Configures the heater for idle preheat for faster start and moisture management.

methods.name: CJ125::isWorkingState
methods.description: Checks if the sensor is in a functioning state, not in error, init, or idle.

methods.name: CJ125::StartHeaterControl
methods.description: Starts PWM-based heater control with optional callback for state changes.

methods.name: CJ125::cjIdentify
methods.description: Reads identification register, verifies register values, and performs communication diagnostics.

methods.name: CJ125::cjSetMode
methods.description: Configures the sensor mode, adjusting register settings and amplification coefficients.

methods.name: CJ125::isValidState
methods.description: Validates current sensor state based on operational status, calibration, and measurement validity.

methods.name: CJ125::cjInitPid
methods.description: Initializes the PID controller parameters based on the engine configuration.
